text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the start of the Mainichi Okan— 
Seiun Sky was gazing at the roster of 
runners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka. Her overwhelming speed as 
a front runner has earned her many fans, 
and she is a formidable powerhouse known 
as the "Otherworldly Fugitive."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, this is a pickle. I really don't 
want to get into a speed duel with 
Suzuka-san.
choice_data_list: Quite the formidable opponent, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay, this is the match everyone's waiting 
forâª Who's gonna win?â

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. I can't really fool 
around as carefree as everyone else, 
though~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka and Seiun Sky. So alike in 
some ways, yet completely different— 
everyone around them was buzzing with 
excitement over their showdown.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, still! I've always wanted to run 
with Suzuka-san someday~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san's out-of-this-world speed, and 
Sei-chan's sharp mind—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's find out which one of us has the 
sharper kick!
